ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, endpoint a is connected to the upper horizontal wire, and endpoint b is connected to the lower horizontal wire; the upper and lower horizontal wires respectively connect the top nodes and the bottom nodes into equipotential nodes. On the left and right sides there is each a vertical side branch, and each side branch is composed of two identical resistors R in series, and the midpoint is also connected through a horizontal resistor to the middle crossing node. In the center of the figure there are two crossing nodes, left and right; each crossing node is respectively connected to the upper wire through two oblique resistors and connected to the lower wire through two oblique resistors; there is also a horizontal resistor between the two crossing nodes. All resistors are R=300 Ω. Then reason: Apply a voltage between a and b. Because the circuit is symmetric with respect to the up-down direction, the left and right side midpoints, the left central crossing point, and the right central crossing point are all at the middle potential of the upper and lower terminal voltages. Therefore the two ends of the horizontal resistors between these midpoints are at equal potential, no current passes through them, and they can be ignored. After ignoring these horizontal resistors with no current, the two left and right outer vertical branches are each R+R=2R, and the two in parallel give an equivalent resistance (2R)||(2R)=R. For each central crossing point, it has two identical resistors R in parallel to the upper wire, equivalent to R/2; it also has two identical resistors R in parallel to the lower wire, equivalent to R/2. Therefore each central crossing point forms an equivalent branch from a to b: R/2+R/2=R. The two branches corresponding to the left and right central crossing points are in parallel, equivalent to R||R=R/2. Finally, the outer part is equivalent to R, the central part is equivalent to R/2, and the two are in parallel: R_ab = R || (R/2) = R/3. Substituting R=300 Ω, get R_ab=300/3=100 Ω.

raw_record.question_text: In the network shown in the figure, all resistors are identical with \(R = 300\,\Omega\). The resistance \(R_{ab}\) (in \(\Omega\)) of the network is _____.

method.method_draft: Apply a voltage between a and b. By top-bottom symmetry, the left side midpoint, left central crossing, right central crossing, and right side midpoint are all at the mid-potential, so the horizontal resistors between these nodes carry zero current and may be ignored. The two outer vertical side paths are each R+R=2R, and the left and right side paths are in parallel, giving R. For each central crossing, two resistors connect to the top rail in parallel giving R/2 and two connect to the bottom rail in parallel giving R/2, so each central crossing contributes R/2+R/2=R from a to b. The two central crossing contributions are in parallel, giving R/2. Finally combine R in parallel with R/2 to get R_ab=R/3=300/3=100 ohms.
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中端点 a 接在上方水平导线上，端点 b 接在下方水平导线上；上、下水平导线分别把顶部节点和底部节点连成等势节点。左右两侧各有一条竖直边支路，每条边支路由上下两个相同电阻 R 串联组成，中点还通过一个水平电阻连到中间交叉节点。图中央有左右两个交叉节点，每个交叉节点分别通过两个斜向电阻连到上方导线、通过两个斜向电阻连到下方导线；两个交叉节点之间还有一个水平电阻。所有电阻均为 R=300 Ω。

再推理：在 a、b 间加电压。由于电路关于上下方向对称，左右侧边中点、左中央交叉点、右中央交叉点都处在上下端电压的中间电位。因此这些中点之间的水平电阻两端等电位，不通过电流，可忽略。

忽略这些无电流的水平电阻后，左右两条外侧竖直支路各为 R+R=2R，两条并联得到等效电阻 (2R)||(2R)=R。

对每个中央交叉点而言，它到上方导线有两个相同电阻 R 并联，等效为 R/2；它到下方导线也有两个相同电阻 R 并联，等效为 R/2。所以每个中央交叉点形成一条从 a 到 b 的等效支路：R/2+R/2=R。左右两个中央交叉点对应的两条支路并联，等效为 R||R=R/2。

最后，外侧部分等效为 R，中央部分等效为 R/2，二者并联：R_ab = R || (R/2) = R/3。代入 R=300 Ω，得 R_ab=300/3=100 Ω。

method.method_draft: Set V_a=V and V_b=0. Write KCL for the four internal nodes L, C, D, and M using the connections read from the image. By left-right and top-bottom symmetry, the solution is L=C=D=M=V/2; the horizontal resistors between internal nodes therefore have zero voltage across them. The total current leaving the top rail is then the sum through the six top-connected resistors visible in the figure: A-L, two A-C diagonals, two A-D diagonals, and A-M. Each carries (V-V/2)/R=V/(2R), so I_total=6·V/(2R)=3V/R. Hence R_ab=V/I_total=R/3=300/3=100 ohms.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：附图中，上方水平导线接端点 a，可视为同一上节点 A；下方水平导线接端点 b，可视为同一下节点 B。电路中间有四个内部中点节点，可记为 L、C、D、M。左、右两侧各有上下两个串联电阻，中点分别为 L 和 M；中间有由斜向电阻组成的对称网络，C、D 是两个中央内部节点；中间水平线上还有 L-C、C-D、D-M 三个电阻。所有电阻均标为 R，题给 R=300 Ω。

推理：令 V_a=V，V_b=0，四个内部节点电位分别为 V_L、V_C、V_D、V_M。按图中连接关系列 KCL，并把每个电阻都取为 R：
节点 L：((V_L-V)/R)+(V_L/R)+((V_L-V_C)/R)=0，即 3V_L-V_C=V。
节点 C：2((V_C-V)/R)+2(V_C/R)+((V_C-V_L)/R)+((V_C-V_D)/R)=0，即 6V_C-V_L-V_D=2V。
节点 D：2((V_D-V)/R)+2(V_D/R)+((V_D-V_C)/R)+((V_D-V_M)/R)=0，即 6V_D-V_C-V_M=2V。
节点 M：((V_M-V)/R)+(V_M/R)+((V_M-V_D)/R)=0，即 3V_M-V_D=V。
由于图中网络关于左右和上下均对称，且这些内部中线节点在上下对称下电位应为 V/2；代入也满足上述 KCL 方程，所以 V_L=V_C=V_D=V_M=V/2。
因此 L-C、C-D、D-M 这些水平内部电阻两端电压为零，不流电流。上节点 A 到内部节点共有 6 个可见电阻支路：A-L 一个、到 C 的两个斜向电阻、到 D 的两个斜向电阻、A-M 一个。每个支路电流为 (V-V/2)/R=V/(2R)，总电流 I=6·V/(2R)=3V/R。于是等效电阻 R_ab=V/I=R/3=300/3=100 Ω。

因此 L-C、C-D、D-M 这些水平内部电阻两端电压为零，不流电流。上节点 A 到内部节点共有 6 个可见电阻支路：A-L 一个、到 C 的两个斜向电阻、到 D 的两个斜向电阻、A-M 一个。每个支路电流为 (V-V/2)/R=V/(2R)，总电流 I=6·V/(2R)=3V/R。于是等效电阻 R_ab=V/I=R/3=300/3=100 Ω。

raw_record.original_question: In the network shown in the figure, all resistors are identical with \(R = 300\,\Omega\). The resistance \(R_{ab}\) (in \(\Omega\)) of the network is _____.
raw_record.final_cot:
First describe the image: In the figure, endpoint a is connected to the upper horizontal wire, and endpoint b is connected to the lower horizontal wire; the upper and lower horizontal wires respectively connect the top nodes and the bottom nodes into equipotential nodes. On the left and right sides there is each a vertical side branch, and each side branch is composed of two identical resistors R in series, and the midpoint is also connected through a horizontal resistor to the middle crossing node. In the center of the figure there are two crossing nodes, left and right; each crossing node is respectively connected to the upper wire through two oblique resistors and connected to the lower wire through two oblique resistors; there is also a horizontal resistor between the two crossing nodes. All resistors are R=300 Ω.

Then reason: Apply a voltage between a and b. Because the circuit is symmetric with respect to the up-down direction, the left and right side midpoints, the left central crossing point, and the right central crossing point are all at the middle potential of the upper and lower terminal voltages. Therefore the two ends of the horizontal resistors between these midpoints are at equal potential, no current passes through them, and they can be ignored.

After ignoring these horizontal resistors with no current, the two left and right outer vertical branches are each R+R=2R, and the two in parallel give an equivalent resistance (2R)||(2R)=R.

For each central crossing point, it has two identical resistors R in parallel to the upper wire, equivalent to R/2; it also has two identical resistors R in parallel to the lower wire, equivalent to R/2. Therefore each central crossing point forms an equivalent branch from a to b: R/2+R/2=R. The two branches corresponding to the left and right central crossing points are in parallel, equivalent to R||R=R/2.

Finally, the outer part is equivalent to R, the central part is equivalent to R/2, and the two are in parallel: R_ab = R || (R/2) = R/3. Substituting R=300 Ω, get R_ab=300/3=100 Ω.
